purpose: Controlled question-plan base-model selection; no service execution

prompt.messages: Exact per-case role-specific production formatter capture in rendered-model-requests.json; identical shared messages for all candidates on each case
prompt.referenceRetrieval: Admitted R-v1.1 only; role-filtered; deterministic ordering; unadmitted maintained example arrays excluded
prompt.userRepresentation: wireProjection.inputText in the existing QUESTION data block; previousPlan=null; neutral /assistant context; no new HR prompt guidance

output.schema: Captured existing {plan:CopilotPlan} input JSON schema; exact schema hashes per case
output.validation: Existing Zod + validateCopilotPlan + CEB-SCORE-1 contracted diagnostics
output.malformedPolicy: Record failure; no repair, extraction, defaults beyond existing Zod or retry

transport.networkPolicy: Only exact loopback endpoint in a later reviewed transport; deny all other network/modules; no cloud/fallback

inference.seedSupport: Required in this track; unsupported candidate is excluded, no silent option dropping
inference.familyControl: qwen3_non_thinking adds existing /no_think only after the common user block; other verified non-reasoning families receive no such suffix; record actual body hash

deadlines.include: load, prompt evaluation, generation and full response body
deadlines.parentTermination: Hard terminate request worker; interrupted attempt stays failed

latency.end: complete response body or terminal failure
latency.interruption: Do not resume an old timed attempt; retain error/timeout and stop/re-authorize incomplete run

order.candidateOrder: lexicographic admitted candidateId, frozen before execution
order.caseOrder: MODEL_ELIGIBLE entries in frozen S order
order.warmup: One separate fixed generic structured status control; no S/F case or gold; report cold/warm duration separately

messages.content: Return a JSON object with status equal to ready.

order.scoredFirstCase: Retained; never discard an unfavorable scored load

runManifestRequirements: each candidate identity plus evidence hashes
fresh provider version and binary digest
declared immutable raw attempt/metrics output paths
candidateRunBinding.missingIdentityPolicy: FAIL_CLOSED; a pinned contract is not an admitted candidate or populated executable run manifest

environmentRequirements.cpu: Same CPU-only Windows host and common thread/context/batch/GPU settings
environmentRequirements.capture: Node, OS, arch, CPU model/count, total/free memory, runtime build/version, exact dependency lock, peak working set and available thermal/power conditions; never host/user/serial or secrets
environmentRequirements.timing: Disable unrelated voice/model profiling; record background-load/power uncertainty; fresh per-candidate capture
environmentRequirements.versions: Fresh Ollama /api/version and artifact metadata inspection later, no hidden generation; historical metadata insufficient

outputEvidence.rawAttempts: New run-specific append-only synthetic attempt files; no overwriting prior attempts
outputEvidence.metrics: Separate hash-bound CEB-SCORE-1 report; all error/timeout/missing denominators
outputEvidence.bodyRecord: Bounded raw synthetic model output, response/error code, monotonic duration, token usage and safe Ollama durations
outputEvidence.seal: Final output manifest after completion or abort; record incomplete run honestly
